title: Physician (MD General Medicine)

milestones.title: MD (or DNB) in General Medicine
milestones.detail: Choose General Medicine when you are allotted a postgraduate seat. NEET-SS accepts it for the medical super-specialties, including cardiology, neurology and nephrology.
